A quiet notebook your AI agent can read

Lumen Notes keeps every note as a plain markdown file on your own disk. It syncs those files between your laptop, your phone and your tablet, and it can publish any notebook as a small website. Nothing is locked into a database you cannot open, and nothing needs a special exporter when you decide to move on.

Why plain files

Plain files outlive applications. A folder of markdown opens in any editor, searches with any tool and diffs cleanly under version control. Lumen Notes adds a fast editor, backlinks and tags on top of that folder, but the folder stays the source of truth. If you stop using the app tomorrow, your notes are still right where you left them.

Built for agents as well as people

Every published notebook ships with an llms.txt index, a markdown twin of each page and structured data in the page head. A coding agent or a search assistant can read the notebook without guessing at the layout, and a person sees the same content in a clean, readable theme.

Sync without surprises

Sync runs over an end-to-end encrypted channel. Conflicts are kept side by side as two files instead of being merged silently, so you always decide which version wins. Offline edits are queued and sent the next time a device comes online.

Getting started

Download the app for your system, point it at an empty folder or an existing one, and start writing. The first notebook is free forever; larger teams can add shared notebooks and an admin panel on a paid plan.

Read the install guide or compare the plans.
